text_en: Suppose two persons have a dispute and enter into litigation, and the judges decide between them, declaring one to be in the right and the other to be in the wrong.
text_cn: 几时人与人之间发生争讼，而对簿公庭，定案时，正直的，应声明他正直；有罪的，应判定他有罪；

text_en: If the one in the wrong deserves to be flogged, the judge shall make that person lie down and be beaten in his presence with the number of lashes proportionate to the offense.
text_cn: 如有罪的应受鞭刑，判官应命他伏下，当面按他的罪照数鞭打；

text_en: Forty lashes may be given but not more; if more lashes than these are given, your neighbor will be degraded in your sight.
text_cn: 只可打他四十下，不可再多；怕鞭打他超过这数目，你的兄弟在你眼前过于受辱。

text_en: You shall not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.
text_cn: 牛在打场的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。

text_en: When brothers reside together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the deceased shall not be married outside the family to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, taking her in marriage, and performing the duty of a husband’s brother to her,
text_cn: 如果兄弟住在一起，其中一个没有留下儿子就死了；死者的妻子不可出嫁外人，丈夫的兄弟应走近她，以她为妻，对她履行兄弟的义务。

text_en: and the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed to the name of the deceased brother, so that his name may not be blotted out of Israel.
text_cn: 她所生的长子，应归亡兄名下，免得他的名由以色列中消灭。

text_en: But if the man has no desire to marry his brother’s widow, then his brother’s widow shall go up to the elders at the gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to perpetuate his brother’s name in Israel; he will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me. ”
text_cn: 若是那人不肯娶他兄弟的妻子，他兄弟的妻子应到城门去见长老说：“我丈夫的兄弟不愿在以色列中给自己的兄弟留名，不愿对我尽兄弟的义务。”

text_en: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and speak to him. If he persists, saying, “I have no desire to marry her, ”
text_cn: 本城的长老应叫那人来，对他说明；如他仍坚持说：“我不愿娶她。”

text_en: then his brother’s wife shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, pull his sandal off his foot, spit in his face, and declare, “This is what is done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house. ”
text_cn: 他兄弟的妻子应当着长老的面，走到他跟前，从他脚上脱下他的鞋，向他脸上吐唾沫说：“那不愿给自己兄弟建立家室的人，应这样对待他。”

text_en: Throughout Israel his family shall be known as “the house of him whose sandal was pulled off. ”
text_cn: 从此他的名字，在以色列中，将称为“脱鞋者的家”。

text_en: If men get into a fight with one another, and the wife of one intervenes to rescue her husband from the grip of his opponent by reaching out and seizing his genitals,
text_cn: 若两人彼此殴打，一人的妻子前来，救她的丈夫脱离那打他者的手，伸手抓住了那人的阴部；

text_en: you shall cut off her hand; show no pity.
text_cn: 你应砍去她的手，不应表示怜惜。

text_en: You shall not have in your bag two kinds of weights, large and small.
text_cn: 在你袋里不可有两样法码：一大一小；

text_en: You shall not have in your house two kinds of measures, large and small.
text_cn: 在你家内也不可有两样升斗：一大一小。

text_en: You shall have only a full and honest weight; you shall have only a full and honest measure, so that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
text_cn: 你应有准确公正的法码，应有准确公正的升斗，好使你在上主你的天主赐给你的地上，得享长寿；

text_en: For all who do such things, all who act dishonestly, are abhorrent to the Lord your God.
text_cn: 因为凡做这些事的，凡做事不公平的，于上主你的天主都是可憎恶的。

text_en: Remember what Amalek did to you on your journey out of Egypt,
text_cn: 你应记得，当你由埃及出来时，阿玛肋克在路上怎样对待了你：

text_en: how he attacked you on the way, when you were faint and weary, and struck down all who lagged behind you; he did not fear God.
text_cn: 怎样在路上袭击了你，乘你困乏无力，攻击你后方所有疲惫的人，一点也不怕天主。

text_en: Therefore when the Lord your God has given you rest from all your enemies on every hand, in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; do not forget.
text_cn: 所以，当上主你的天主赐你摆脱你四周的一切仇敌，在上主你的天主赐给你作产业的地上，安享太平时，你应由天下抹去阿玛肋克的名字；不可忘记！
